profile.headline: Software Engineer III | Full-Stack Development | Interested in Applied AI
profile.summary:
I’m a Full-Stack Software Engineer III with experience contributing to projects across financial management, childcare subsidy coordination, entertainment, and car rental services. Working with clients across these industries has given me exposure to different business needs, workflows, and technical challenges.
I’m especially interested in opportunities that combine full-stack development with artificial intelligence. I want to build on my engineering experience to develop practical applications that solve meaningful problems and make complex tasks easier for the people using them.

positions.title: Assistance Payments Worker
positions.description:
•Diagnose computer problems (troubleshooting)
•Provide user education
•Set-up/breakdown computer equipment
•Link devices to peripheral equipment (i.e., printers, scanners, drive configuration)
•Answer tech-related questions
•Demonstrate and troubleshoot software usage
•Provide user assistance with Windows operating systems

positions.title: Practicum in Business Excellence Internship Program
positions.description:
This internship program provided small group instruction for graduating student(s) and business professionals in foundational SAP courses and business excellence.  Specific focus was given to content proficiency, understanding client business needs, effective solution delivery, and business acumen. 

Upon successful completion of this internship program, the following skills were acquired: 

- SAP Navigation and Foundational knowledge
- Basic SAP Business Process Integration
- Use of remote communication technology 
- Conducting effective business meetings (in-person and remotely)
- Professional attire and interpersonal interaction in a business setting
- Effective client business need and issue resolution (documentation, research, solution and follow-up)
 
A certificate of completion was provided at the end of the internship.
